BookWIIM — Books Recommended So Far

Page counts refer to a particular edition and may vary. New Goodreads snapshots were researched on 4 October 2026; original shelf ratings are retained. These are not live scores. Search results may reflect earlier crawls. Age guidance is advisory, not a content rating. Amazon links search the Indian store so you can choose an edition.

What’s included · sources and coverage

Book-club recommendations, the Book The Worm spreadsheet and the Secret Santa 2025 spreadsheet, deduplicated against the original shelf. Awards and list appearances attach to existing books too; each badge links to its source.

  • Booker Prize: all book winners, 1969–2025, including shared prizes and the Lost Booker. International Booker: book winners, 2016–2026; earlier prizes honoured an author’s body of work.
  • Oprah’s Book Club and Reese’s Book Club: published selections through the source archives checked on 4 October 2026, including Reese’s YA selections.
  • 2021–2025 annual lists: the New York Times Top 10; The New Yorker’s year-end essentials; Barack Obama’s year-end favourites; The Guardian’s annual category roundups.
  • Crossword Book Award: book winners from the resumed 2024 and 2025 awards. No 2026 winners have been added.
  • Business: Financial Times Business Book of the Year winners, 2010–2025.
  • Goodreads: Choice Award winners in every category, 2015–2025. These are readers’ annual votes, not a ranking of every book by its average rating.

2026 year-end lists and Goodreads voting are not yet complete. This file is a dated snapshot. Additional individually verified prize wins are also credited, including Pulitzer, Hugo and Women’s Prize wins. A missing badge means no match was verified within this research; it does not mean a book has never won an award.

Short attributed description excerpts come from the linked book record. Existing BookWIIM premises and ratings are retained. Children’s age bands are BookWIIM editorial suggestions based on intended audience and format. Series and ambiguous references have their own shelves.
